summary: All 3 new features + regression verified end-to-end (backend 6/6 pytest PASS + frontend playwright PASS). (1) HARD-DELETE CANCEL: POST /api/events/{id}/cancel returns {ok:true, deleted:true}; the event vanishes from GET /api/events and all matching attendance rows are cascade-deleted (verified via direct Mongo count). Legacy soft-cancelled docs (cancelled:true injected directly into Mongo) are correctly filtered out by the $or query in get_events. (2) RSVP REMINDERS: creating an event ~25h in the future, ensuring josh has email+Aktiv and no attendance row, then GET /api/unread?player_id=josh-ankermann atomically upserts one rsvp_reminder:{eid}:{josh}:slotN marker in db.system_events (proving the atomic marker is inserted BEFORE the Resend send call — even with placeholder RESEND_API_KEY the exception is caught after the marker exists). A second /api/unread within the same 5-min window does not add a new reminder_scan or rsvp_reminder marker (5-min debounce lock works). After inserting attendance status=zugesagt and clearing debounce, a fresh scan inserts ZERO new rsvp_reminder markers for that pair (answered players skip). Scope test: an event 5 days out (>48h) produces 0 markers. (3) FRONTEND fahre button hidden on home games: seeded 1 home (opponent 'TestHome FC', home_game=true → home === 'TuS Oberhausen II') and 1 away (home_game=false → home === 'TestAway FC') game via /api/events, logged in as josh-ankermann / pw12345 on mobile viewport (390x844), navigated to Termine tab and scrolled — [data-testid="fahre-{home_id}"] is ABSENT while [data-testid="fahre-{away_id}"] is PRESENT. Zusagen/Absagen still render on both. (4) THUMBNAIL REGRESSION: GET /api/players returns josh-ankermann with avatar_file_id set (persisted from iteration_4). GET /api/files/{fid}/thumbnail returns 200 with content-type image/* and payload size ≤ raw size. Pre-existing console warnings (shadow*, props.pointerEvents) carry over from earlier iterations, not introduced now.

critical_code_review_comments: backend/routers/events.py cancel_event: sends push BEFORE the hard delete + cascade-deletes attendance in a separate call. Not transactional but acceptable for the current app size; a Mongo transaction would guard against a mid-request crash leaving orphan attendance, worth noting for the future.

backend/reminders.py check_and_send_rsvp_reminders: correct ordering — the atomic system_events upsert happens BEFORE send_rsvp_reminder, and the send call is wrapped in try/except. That means the debounce/idempotency guarantee holds even if Resend is misconfigured. Good.
reminders.py uses datetime.strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M')[:15] + '0' to build the 5-min slot key; correct rounding but subtle — a comment or helper would improve readability.

reminders.py _to_dt treats the event's local wall-clock time as UTC. That's fine for the current single-timezone team but will drift once DST changes between now and the event. Not urgent; document assumption.
frontend/components/EventCard.tsx line 166: hides fahre button when event.home === CLUB. Handles Trainings/Treffen implicitly (event.type check first). Verified with real seeded events.
